$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it is the captured pipeline with both evaluation commands chained into one step. Both commands appear in a run: block, but the request asks for each in a step of its own.
Every other element is the capture's, so the result is that one deviation.
derivation: The file parses and lints clean and both commands and the upload are present, but each command is invoked by a run: block that holds more than that command, so both command elements miss. Nothing unrequested was added.

elementMisses: command-evaluation-check: the run: block that invokes npx tea-evaluate check --evaluation evals/grader holds more than that command
command-evaluation-ci-pr: the run: block that invokes npx tea-evaluate ci --evaluation evals/grader --tier pr holds more than that command
